name: Anthropic Claude (optional upgrade)
summary: Optional component. If an Anthropic API key is supplied at setup, patches the gateway config to use Claude Sonnet as the primary model instead of Qwen2.5-14B. Qwen remains installed and available as a fallback.
notes: Skipped automatically if primary_llm_api_key is not supplied. No effect on local-inference — Qwen is always pulled.
